title: VIP program on Periscope
description: The Periscope VIP program recognizes top content creators with exclusive benefits and badges across three tiers: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. Learn how to apply and what each level offers.

runs: What is the Periscope VIP program?

is designed to recognize and support broadcasters who create some of the most incredible content on our platform. VIPs have access to benefits like VIP badges, and tools that empower them to further grow their audience. The program consists of 3 VIP levels: Bronze, Silver and Gold. Having access to each level unlocks a number of benefits associated with that tier.
